summary: Tested the course tabs that replace 'hello <city>'. All requested items pass. Unit tests: 38 passed. Integration tests: test_courses_api.py has 9 new tests and test_citysites_api.py has 27 updated tests, 36/36 passing. On the preview (Ottawa), courses-heading reads 'Courses in and around Ottawa'. tab-newcomer has aria-current=page by default. Counts were newcomer 5, advanced 2, online 88. I checked these counts against my own pull of the Unity API (4 pages, 305 courses, offset = page number) using the same haversine, window and mctype filters, and they match exactly. The newcomer list shows Gatineau 2 km, Ottawa 10 km (x2), Stittsville 23 km and Kanata 23 km, sorted by date. Expanding a card shows Schedule (local time), Venue, Teachers, Fee (with student and repeater prices), Language and Contact, plus a Register link to enroll.artofliving.org/ca-en/programs/... with target=_blank and rel=noopener. Clicking again collapses the card. ?tab=advanced shows only VTP and Part 2. ?tab=online shows only online courses, with 'Organiser near Ottawa' courses first. The EN/FR switch keeps the tab (/?lang=fr&tab=online answers 303 to /?tab=online) and shows French tabs, dates ('mar. 17 nov.') and 24h times ('11 h 00'). An unknown tab falls back to newcomer. Admin /admin/sites: radius 0, months 13 and an empty longitude each showed site-config-error with a clear message. Saving radius 200 and months 3 worked: the subheading read 'within 200 km ... next 3 months' and the counts went to 17/3/99, now including Montreal and Pointe-Claire. 'Reset to file' brought back the configuration file and 50 km / 2 months. Caching: 'Fetched 300 courses from the Unity API in 3 page(s)' is logged once per backend process start, and once more only when monthsAhead goes above the cached window. Across about 170 GET / requests there were no other fetches. /api/home-content?tab=online returns {html, css}, and an unknown host gets 404. Regression: unknown host 404, /healthz 200, 'My dashboard' in the header when signed in, and the admin APIs (config, logs, texts, users, roles) all pass. The mobile layout (390px) does not scroll sideways.

minor.issue: The 'Schedule' lines come straight from the API's course_complex_timing in English 12h format ('Fri : 06:00 PM - 08:00 PM'), even on the FR page, which otherwise uses 24h times. Course titles also stay in English because the feed is language=en-ca.

issues: The tab bar scrolls sideways and 'Advanced courses' is cut off with no scroll hint (fade or arrow), so the Online tab is easy to miss.
The API labels a K1T postcode venue (3028 Victoria Heights Cres) as 'Ottawa (Centre Town)' 10 km away. This is a data issue in the API, not an app bug.

action_items: Optional: show the Schedule times in the locale's format on the FR page, or label them as provided by the organiser.
Optional: add a scroll hint to the course tabs on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: CourseFeed.get holds the asyncio lock for the whole fetch (up to 30 pages x 30s timeout). On a cold cache or after expiry, every home request waits for the fetch. Consider serving stale data while one background refresh runs once the TTL has passed.
Every backend hot reload or restart starts with an empty cache and fetches again. This is fine in production but adds API calls during development.
_fetch stops early when the last start_date of a page is past the horizon. This depends on order_by=start_date in UNITY_COURSES_API_URL; keep that parameter in the env URL.
select_courses leaves out courses that have already started (start < now), so a multi-day course running today disappears. Probably intended.
After 'Reset to file', the feed keeps the larger cached window (_months=3). This is harmless.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with -n 0: python -m pytest tests/test_courses_api.py tests/test_citysites_api.py -n 0. Both modules change the admin config and must not run in parallel. Editing any file under /app/backend (tests included) triggers a uvicorn reload and one Unity fetch. The Unity API needs a User-Agent header; offset is a page number. Create Clerk sign-in tickets with backend/tests/make_ticket.py <user_id>. The admin logs/texts/users pages were checked through their APIs only; the UI selector 'main' did not exist there.
